book.name: 1 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Amakeerenʼya
Ɨnyarʉbha yɨnʉ nandikirɨ inyɨ Paaurʉ, nɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ nu umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichɨtʉ Sʉsitɨɨnɨ. Inyɨ nɨkabhirikirwa kʉbha umutumwa
wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ kʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa Mungu.
Tʉrabhaandɨkɨra imwɨ abhiisirirya bhʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kʉrintʉ. Mungu abharʉbhwɨrɨ na kʉbhɨngukibhwa na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, abhabhirikiirɨ kʉbha abharɨndu
bhaazɨ. Tʉrabhaandɨkɨra imwɨ hamwɨmwɨ na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bha zɨmbaara zʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakosengera Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waabhʉ nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi no omorembe kurwa kwa Bhaabha Mungu, na kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ.
Paaurʉ arabhʉʉrɨra Mungu azʉmiryɨ
Nɨrabhʉʉrɨra Mungu azʉmiryɨ ibhaga ryʉsi igʉrʉ waanyu, kʉ kʉbha ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨnʉ abhahɨɨrɨ kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Ku kugwatana kwanyu na Kiriisitʉ muniibhirɨ kʉmangʼana gʉʉsi, kɨnda kʉ kʉgamba kwanyu na kʉbhʉmɨnyi bhwanyu.
Gayo gareerekenʼya kʉbha amangʼana ganʉ twabharwaziirɨ igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ, nɨ‑ga amaheene.
Nangʉ mʉtasuuhiirwɨ nʉʉrʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhʉmwɨ bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu,
mʉkɨɨrɨ mʉrarɨnda kwa mɨɨga marʉrʉ ʉkʉgarʉka kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Mungu arabhakongʼya kuhika mʉtɨnɨrʉ, korereke mʉtaaza kʉbha ni isoro, urusikʉ rʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ akuuza.
Mungu arakora gayo kʉ kʉbha ewe, ne‑moheene. Ewe newe aabhabhirikiirɨ mʉbhɨ ni ikigwatani nu Umwana waazɨ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ.
Ubhumwɨmwɨ gatɨ wa abhiisirirya
Nangʉ, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, nɨrabhiisasaama kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, mʉtabha mʉrataana mʉmagamba. Gatabhaho amataamanʼya gatɨ waanyu, nawe mʉbhɨ na amiisɨɨgi gamwɨ nu ubhwɨndi bhʉmwɨ.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, abhaatʉ obhorebhe bhu Kirowe bhambuuriirɨ, kuni iryʉmana gatɨ waanyu.

Nangʉ, ganʉ nikwenda kʉgamba nego ganʉ, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi gatɨ waanyu bharagamba gaabhʉ. Ʉwʉmwɨ arabhuga, “Inyɨ nɨ‑wa Paaurʉ.” Ʉwʉndɨ arabhuga, “Inyɨ nɨ‑wa Apooro.” Ʉwʉndɨ arabhuga, “Inyɨ nɨ‑wa Peetero.”
Ʉwʉndɨ arabhuga, “Inyɨ nɨ‑wa Kiriisitʉ.”
Nangʉ, Kiriisitʉ atwanɨkɨɨnɨ? Paaurʉ newe aakuurɨ kʉmʉsarabha igʉrʉ waanyu? Mʉkabhatiizwa kuriina rya Paaurʉ?
Nɨrakumya Mungu, kʉ kʉbha nɨtaabhatiizirɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi kwa niimwɨ, kuruushaku Kiriisipʉ na Gaayo.
Atareeho wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kubhuga abhatiizirwɨ kuriina ryanɨ.
Nɨrahiita nɨkabhatiiza kwikɨ abhaatʉ bhu Sitɨfaana. Nawe kʉkɨra bhayo, nɨtɨɨzɨ arɨɨbhɨ nɨkabhatiiza ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ wʉwʉʉsi.

Kiriisitʉ ataantumirɨ inyɨ kʉbhatiiza abhaatʉ. Akantʉma kurwaza Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, atiisɨgirɨ ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwanɨ bhwʉ ʉkʉgamba bhwaheene, korereke uruku rwa Kiriisitʉ kʉmʉsarabha rʉtabhurya amanaga gaazɨ.
Kiriisitʉ newe zinguru nu ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwa Mungu
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhabhurirɨ bhararora kʉbha amangʼana gu ukukwa kwa Kiriisitʉ kʉmʉsarabha, nɨ‑ga kegeege, nawe kwa niitwɨ bhanʉ tʉkʉsabhurwa, amangʼana gayo gareerecha amanaga ga Mungu.
Chɨmbu yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu,

Nangʉ bharɨ hayi bhanʉ tukubhuga bhaanu ubhwʉbhʉʉri? Bharɨ hayi bhanʉ tukubhuga ni‑bhiija bhi imigirʉ ja Musa, nʉʉrʉ abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhɨɨzɨ kʉgamba bhwaheene zisikʉ zɨnʉ? Mungu ɨrɨkɨɨnʼyɨ habhwɨrʉ kʉbha ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ, ne‑bhogeege.

Nɨragambabhu, kʉ kʉbha Mungu, kubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwazɨ, akeenda abhaatʉ bhatatʉra komomenya kʉnzɨra yu ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwabhʉ abheene. Nawe Mungu akasɨɨga kʉbhasabhʉra bhanʉ bhakumwisirirya kʉnzɨra ya amangʼana ganʉ tʉkʉraganʼya. Amangʼana gayo, abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatɨɨzɨ Mungu, bharabhuga nɨ‑ga kegeege.
Abhayaahudi bhareenda ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ kurwa mwisaarʉ korereke bhiisiriryɨ, Abhagiriki bharamohya ubhwʉbhʉʉri.
Nawe itwɨ, tʉraraganʼya amangʼana igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ wʉnʉ aakuurɨ kʉmʉsarabha. Amangʼana gayo garanyahaara Abhayaahudi, na kʉbhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi nɨ‑mangʼana ga kegeege.
Nawe kʉbhanʉ Mungu aabhabhirikiirɨ abhaazɨ, bhabhɨ Abhayaahudi hamwɨ bhabhɨ Abhagiriki, Kiriisitʉ newe amanaga ga Mungu nu ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwa Mungu.
Amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora kʉbha ne‑bhogeege bhwa Mungu, garakɨra ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwa abhaatʉ. Na ganʉ bhakorora kʉbha nɨ‑bhʉnyʉʉhɨrɨru bhwa Mungu, gana amanaga kʉkɨra amanaga ga abhaatʉ.

Nangʉ, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, muhiitɨ chɨmbu mwarɨ hanʉ mwabhirikiirwɨ na Mungu. Kumiisɨɨgi ga abhaatʉ, bhaaru gatɨ waanyu bhataarɨ nu ubhwʉbhʉʉri. Naatu abhaaru gatɨ waanyu mʉtaarɨ mʉramenyekana bhʉkʉngʼu, na mutiibhwirwɨ mumijɨ ja abhataakɨ.

Nawe Mungu akarobhora amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora ne‑bhogeege, korereke abhasuuchɨ bhu ubhwʉbhʉʉri. Na Mungu akarobhora amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora nɨ‑bhʉnyʉʉhɨrɨru, korereke abhasuuchɨ bha amanaga.
Na Mungu akarobhora amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora gataana ubhusuuku na ganʉ bhakorega, na ganʉ bhakorora gataana nzobhooro, korereke asaryɨ amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora gane enzobhooro.
Akakorabhu korereke ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atiikumya mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu.
Mungu newe abhagwatɨɨnʼyɨ imwɨ na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Ewe akʉrirɨ Kiriisitʉ abhɨ ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwɨtʉ. Kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu tʉbhɨɨrɨ bhe eheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu, tʉbhɨɨrɨ abharɨndu, na tʉsabhwirwɨ.
Chɨmbu yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwikumya, ikumyɨ igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.”
